war.help_war_val:
`!clan` - Clan general info
`!list` - Member list + roles
`!tags` - Member names and tags
`!wars` - River race status
`!contribution` - Contribution ranks
`!inactive` - Players with 0 medals
`!warlog` - Last 5 wars summary
war.help_stats_val:
`!graph` - Fame history graph
`!player_board [#TAG]` - War performance table
`!prediction [extra]` - War result prediction
war.help_profile_val:
`!profile [#TAG/@mention]` - Detailed player profile
`!activity` - 0-100 activity score
`!kicklist [count]` - Kick suggestion
`!promote` - Promotion suggestion
`!history #TAG` - Activity history
war.help_badges_val:
`!my_badges [#TAG]` - Earned badges
`!badge_rank` - Badge leaderboard
`!badges` - All badge descriptions
war.help_deck_val:
`!deck` - Random meta deck
`!deck_suggest [arena]` - Deck by arena
`!deck_random` - Random fun deck
`!meta` - All meta decks
war.help_records_val:
`!records` - All clan records
`!record_history [cat]` - Record history
`!record_reset [cat]` - Reset (Admin)
war.help_report_val:
`!weekly` - Instant weekly report
`!weekly_config` - Auto report toggle
war.help_channels_val:
`!set_channel <type> #c` - Assign channel
`!remove_channel <type>` - Remove channel
`!list_channels` - Show channel assignments
`!test_channel <type>` - Send test msg
war.help_other_val:
`!royaleapi` - RoyaleAPI extra stats
`!grant_auth @user` - Grant auth
`!revoke_auth @user` - Revoke auth
